item: macOS portability legs run four xdist workers; hang, slow and fail reports armed in each worker
summary: Windows shard 2 took 5,137 s in one process (3.7x its Linux cost; time spread over file-heavy tests). -n 4 --dist loadfile took the macOS legs from near 60 min to 16-21 (run 44355305198); on Windows the same tests took 4-6x longer with four running and the legs still capped, so Windows stays in one process. The report settings, taken out of the environment at import, now reach workers through workerinput; each worker writes name.gwN, the controller none, and the CI step prints them all.
